title: Verify company address displays correctly in footer

test_data.expected_address: Skyline, 1240 N Homan Ave, Chicago, IL 60651

steps: Scroll to the footer company-info block
expected_result: Footer displays the exact address text 'Skyline, 1240 N Homan Ave, Chicago, IL 60651' as plain text (not a clickable link).

title: Verify company email displays correctly in footer
steps: Scroll to the footer company-info block
Check whether the email text is rendered as a clickable mailto: link or as plain text
expected_result: Footer displays 'sales@skyline.glass' as plain text with no mailto: link. This is documented current behavior and is not treated as a defect.

title: Verify company phone number displays correctly in footer
steps: Scroll to the footer company-info block
Read the displayed phone number text
Check whether the phone text is rendered as a clickable tel: link or as plain text
expected_result: Footer displays '773-278-4660' as plain text with no tel: link. This is documented current behavior and is not treated as a defect.
